run_mag_experiment_train: run the MAG240M-LSC experiment in train mode using python -m ogb_lsc.mag.experiment with jaxline_mode=train
run_mag_experiment_eval: run the MAG240M-LSC experiment in eval mode to produce predictions with a pretrained model
run_mag_experiment_multithreaded: run the MAG240M-LSC experiment in train_eval_multithreaded mode with early stopping on a separate eval thread
review_experiment_class: review the Experiment class which extends Jaxline AbstractExperiment for MAG240M-LSC node property prediction training and evaluation
review_bgrl_loss_method: review the _bgrl_loss method that computes supervised loss combined with BGRL self-supervised contrastive loss on corrupted graph views
